decisions.reason: This rye country bread sits squarely within the bakery’s core bread knowledge and, after remaining in the range for another year without any negative signal, management would normally continue it.
As a flagship premium raisin stollen with a gold-medal quality signal and very strong fit to the firm’s established confectionery capabilities, it is highly unlikely to be withdrawn.
The dark barley malt rye bread is somewhat more specialised but still relies on familiar rye-baking competence, so the firm is more likely to fine-tune positioning and recipe than to remove it.

Ancient grain bread remains the most exploratory offer, but because it still builds on existing bread-making know-how and another year on the market gives the firm more learning to assimilate, management would keep it for now.
